messages:
Priya: Quick sync 1: we have a pending SDK pin for customers using the legacy streaming protocol. Need to lock SDK to 2.7.3 for the next 48h while we roll a compatibility fix.
Liam: Reason? is it a protocol regression or a perf bug?
Priya: It's a protocol regression: new runtime 3.x changed chunk headers; older SDKs (<=2.7.2) will mis-parse trailing frames causing silent truncation.
Zoe: Oof. Do we pin at the routing layer or block via feature-flag?
Priya: Routing layer pin preferred 3: deploybot can add sdk-pin rule for requests with header X-SDK-Version <=2.7.2 and route them to runtime-2.15 compat pool.
Carlos: That will protect customers but might increase load on compat pool. Do we have capacity headroom?
Nina: We have a spare 10% buffer in compat pool for 24h. Ops suggested a soft-throttle to keep headroom.
deploybot: deploybot: action queued by @Priya 1: create sdk-compat-pin rule -> route sdk<=2.7.2 to pool:runtime-2.15-compat. Change window starts 2026-03-30T00:30:00Z for 48h.
Liam: Can we add an exemption list for customers who have been pre-upgraded to SDK 2.8+? we don't want to hamstring them.
Priya: Yes 3: planned exemption: customer IDs cust-113, cust-422. We'll pass those ids in the rule.
Zoe: Also recommend a 10% sampled telemetry tag so we can trace impacted calls easily: header X-Compat-Pin: yes.
Carlos: Ops note: if we route >5% extra traffic to compat pool, enable throttling at 85% CPU to avoid OOMs.
ops-bot: ops-bot: preflight checks running 1: capacity check: compat pool headroom 12% OK; throttles configured.
Priya: Good. Docs: short comms to customers needed. We should add a banner on the dashboard and send an email to SDK users.
docs-bot: docs-bot: drafted notice posted to docs/downtime: "Temporary SDK routing pin for legacy stream protocol (affects SDK <=2.7.2). Upgrade to SDK 2.8+ to avoid routing to compat pool." Will schedule dashboard banner.
Liam: Rollback criteria? if compat pool error rate >1% or p99 latency increased >50% vs baseline -> revert rule. Also if we detect truncated streams in logs > 10/min -> revert.
Priya: Agreed. Also capture a 30-minute window of raw request traces for any revert.
Zoe: Can we add a runtime-level shim instead? small change to runtime 3.x parser to accept old chunk header variant? That could avoid pinning.
Priya: Engineering is triaging the shim now; ETA 6-12h. But we need stopgap routing rule while fix arrives.
Liam: For QA: please run the following smoke test against the compat route during the first hour after rollout:
Liam: ```bash
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
  curl -s -H "X-SDK-Version: 2.7.0" -H "X-Trace: smoke-$i" "https://api.redwood.internal/generate?long_seq=1" | jq -e '.streaming_frames | length > 0' || echo "fail $i";
done
```
Priya: Zoe will run it at +15m after start. Zoe: got it.
Carlos: Add one more: simulate many small streams (1000 reqs/min) to verify backpressure.
Priya: Noted. Ops will schedule a load job for +30m.
ops-bot: ops-bot: scheduled loadtest at +30m: target 1k rpm for 10m against compat pool.
deploybot: deploybot: sdk-pin rule created and in dry-run mode. To apply live, run: `deploybot apply-rule sdk-compat-pin --live`
Liam: Let's keep dry-run for the first 20m of the window then flip live if dry-run shows correct routing.
Priya: Sounds safe. Also capture a sampling of raw chunk bytes for any streamed response for post-mortem.
Zoe: One more thing: add a telemetry signal for SDK update attempts. A spike in X-SDK-Upgrade header with value 2.8+ would indicate customers upgrading quickly.
Nina: I'll coordinate with CS to include a short upgrade guide and the compatibility table.
Priya: Nightshift handoff 4: @Carlos you'll be primary on-call for the window; @Liam backup. I'll own comms.
Carlos: On it. Will watch compat dashboards and paging.
Liam: If rollback required, steps: 1) deploybot revert-rule sdk-compat-pin 2) pinlist remove 3) notify CS + open incident.
Priya: Add runbook link: https://intra/runbooks/sdk-compat-pin (includes script snippets and rollback commands).
Carlos: One final check: are any internal automated clients (metrics exporters, canary bots) using SDK <=2.7.2? Don't want to route our own telemetry to compat pool.
ops-bot: ops-bot: scanned internal clients: all internal agents use sdk 2.8+. No action.
deploybot: deploybot: dry-run mode will begin at 2026-03-30T00:30:00Z. Live apply pending manual confirmation at +20m.
Priya: OK team. If no objections in 30m I'll hit apply-dry-run. Please ack here when you finish your prechecks.
Liam: ack.
Zoe: ack, smoke test ready.
Carlos: ack, pager ready.
Nina: ack, docs banner queued.
